title: XAI in Computational Linguistics: Understanding Political Leanings in the Slovenian Parliament
reasoning: The paper focuses on applying explainable AI (XAI) techniques to classify political leanings in parliamentary speeches. While it mentions 'Christian' and 'Christian Democrat' as keywords associated with right-leaning parties, it does so in the context of political party names rather than evaluating religious beliefs, faith traditions, or formal ethical frameworks.
